name: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku o! ~Kono Yokubou no Ishou ni Chouai o!~
original_name: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を！ ～この欲望の衣装に寵愛を！～
source:
The story of Kono Yokubou no Ishou ni Chouai wo features the KonoSuba  party, who during one of their usual quests, find a cursed tablet that lets its user freely generate clothes. The cast all get cursed with  personality-reverse. Darkness turns into a sadistic queen, Megumin turns  into a lolita and starts a Lolita Alliance, and Aqua turns into an actual goddess-like person. The characters will need to make and wear specific clothes with the tablet to break the curse. It’s a game where  you can enjoy typical comedy situations of KonoSuba along with  the cast acting out of character and wearing different costumes. Hence the Japanese subtitle, which can be translated to “Love For the Costumes of Desires".

[from [url=https://es.gamingoverdoseplus.com/post/konosuba-kono-yokubou-no-ishou-ni-chouai-wo-announced-on-ps4-switch]Gaming Overdose[/url]]
translation:
《為欲望的衣裝獻上寵愛！》講述了《為美好的世界獻上祝福！》主角一行人的故事。他們在一次尋常的任務中，發現了一塊能讓使用者自由製作衣服的詛咒石板。眾人因此中了詛咒，性格全都反了過來。達克妮絲變成了施虐女王，惠惠接受了自己的蘿莉形象，還成立了蘿莉同盟，阿克婭則變得真正像一位女神。為了解除詛咒，他們必須用石板製作並穿上指定的服裝。在遊戲中，玩家既能享受《為美好的世界獻上祝福！》一貫的喜劇情節，也能看到角色們一反常態的舉動和各式各樣的裝扮。這也正是日文副標題「為欲望的衣裝獻上寵愛」的由來。
